property_summary: For every call to Put by any sender, the correct contract always performs an external call to Log.AddMessage (so calling Put on c will not revert when the Log contract's fallback/receive reverts is handled by the caller), whereas the mutated contract that removed the logging call will differ in whether an external call occurs; we detect this by deploying a LoggingReverter that reverts when called — the reference will make the external call and thus the Put will revert (try/catch observes false) while the mutant (which removed the call) will succeed (try/catch observes true) for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Replace the LogFile.AddMessage call with no logging (deleted), which changes observable emitted logs after Put.
